name: FeB4RAG
description: FeB4RAG is a dataset designed for evaluating federated search systems in the context of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). It contains 790 information requests derived from 16 sub-collections of the BEIR benchmark, with LLM-derived relevance judgments, supporting the development and evaluation of federated search methods tailored for RAG pipelines.
reputation: A newer, specialized benchmark with limited but growing use for evaluating federated retrieval in RAG settings.
notes: Focuses on federated search evaluation within RAG frameworks; includes conversational query-like information requests and LLM relevance judgments.
